title: D2B: E-commerce & Operations Coordinator (Pharma/Supplements) - NZ
description: Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b About the Company The client is a New Zealand-based wellness brand specialising in nutritional supplements and wellness products. The company is committed to developing high-quality, science-led products that support everyday health and wellbeing. With a growing presence across New Zealand and Australia, they continue to expand its e-commerce, wholesale, and retail operations while maintaining a strong focus on product quality and customer experience. About the Role We are looking for a highly organised and proactive E-commerce & Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of a growing wellness brand across New Zealand and Australia. This is a broad, hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working across multiple areas of a business, including e-commerce, customer experience, wholesale account management, supply chain, inventory coordination, and project administration. Working closely with the Head of Operations, you will play an important role in keeping business operations running smoothly, coordinating with customers, retailers, suppliers, manufacturers, and logistics partners, and ensuring that operational processes, documentation, and reporting are maintained accurately. The ideal candidate is commercially minded, detail-oriented, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of tasks in a fast-paced, growing business. Key Responsibilities 1. E-commerce & Customer Experience • Manage customer enquiries across email, live chat, helpdesk, website, and social media channels. • Oversee online order processing, tracking, amendments, cancellations, refunds, returns, and subscription changes. • Coordinate with couriers and third-party logistics (3PL) providers to resolve delivery issues and fulfilment discrepancies. • Monitor customer feedback, identify recurring issues, and prepare monthly customer insights reports. 2. Brand & Influencer Coordination • Manage day-to-day communications across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok, following established brand guidelines. • Coordinate influencer and UGC creator outreach, applications, product gifting, campaign timelines, and deliveries. • Maintain creator databases, campaign trackers, usage rights, posting schedules, and partnership documentation. • Support PR activities, brand collaborations, and monthly influencer reporting. 3. Wholesale & Retail Operations • Coordinate new wholesale account enquiries, onboarding, and ongoing retailer relationships. • Process wholesale orders, confirmations, and invoicing using Unleashed. • Maintain wholesale pricing, product information, retailer documentation, and promotional materials. • Coordinate with distributors, retail partners, warehouses, and logistics providers to ensure timely order fulfilment. • Support wholesale reporting, sales performance tracking, and retailer re-order activities. 4. Supply Chain & Inventory Coordination • Assist with production scheduling, purchase orders, supplier follow-ups, and import/export logistics. • Monitor stock levels, inventory movements, batch tracking, expiry dates, and warehouse accuracy. • Liaise with manufacturers, suppliers, freight providers, and 3PL partners across New Zealand and Australia. • Track production timelines, warehouse transfers, delivery documentation, and supplier milestones. • Support demand forecasting, inventory reporting, and monthly supply and operations planning. 5. Project & Business Operations • Coordinate new product development activities, including product documentation, specifications, costing records, and production timelines. • Support product launches, packaging readiness, and operational project administration. • Maintain operational trackers, master data, dashboards, SOPs, and shared documentation. • Assist with business-wide projects, process improvements, system integration, and operational reporting. • Provide regular progress updates and administrative support to the Head of Operations. • 3+ years of experience in operations coordination, e-commerce operations, supply chain, or a similar role. • Experience in supplements, nutraceuticals, health and wellness, food and beverage, or FMCG industries is highly desirable. • Hands-on experience with Shopify, including order management, customer service, subscriptions, and e-commerce reporting. • Background in wholesale/B2B operations, account management, order processing, invoicing, and retailer coordination. • Knowledge of inventory management, stock forecasting, purchase orders, supplier coordination, and warehouse fulfilment. • Familiarity with inventory management or ERP systems, particularly Unleashed, is an advantage. • Excellent organisational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently. What We're Looking For We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked in growing consumer brands, especially within the wellness, supplements, food and beverage, or FMCG industries. You don't necessarily need experience in every area of the role, but you should bring a strong foundation in e-commerce and business operations, with the versatility to support different functions and take ownership of day-to-day responsibilities. If you're someone who enjoys bringing structure to operations, solving problems, coordinating people and processes, and contributing to the growth of a dynamic business, we'd love to hear from you. • Remote / WFH • New Zealand Business Hours To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-e-commerce-operations-coordinator-pharma-supplements-nz

title: SweetSpot Heating and Cooling: Creative Strategist (AI-Native, Direct Response)
description: Headquarters: New York, New York, United States URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/ About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale. About the role We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch. This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend. What you will do • Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research. • Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency. • Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad. • Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad. • Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named. • Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round. • Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows. What we are looking for • Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them. • A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations. • Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses. • AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how. • Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads. • Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed. • Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here. Pay and structure • Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience. • Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads. • Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales. Our hiring process (exactly how it works) • Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow). • Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete. • Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario. • Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more. • Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30. We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

title: Abnormal: AI Security Sales Executive, North Central
description: Headquarters: Remote - USA ABOUT THE ROLE AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market. The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will work alongside the Account Executives who know our customers best: joining land motions, driving AI Security expansion across our 5,000+ customers, and running focused outbound to win net new logos in the largest enterprises. Early on, most of your focus will be expansion. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it. The timing matters. Abnormal is growing quickly, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up regularly in customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. You will have real say in how this category gets sold. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Own AI Security in your region. Carry the AI Security quota and run the sales cycle from first conversation through close. • Drive expansion across our customer base. Lead upsell campaigns into customers who already trust Abnormal, and join land motions where AI Security belongs in the conversation. • Run focused pipeline generation. Build a targeted, strategic outbound motion to open net new logos in the largest enterprises, partnering with the core AE where a relationship exists. Quality over volume. • Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your region, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most. • Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on AI governance, agent security, and cloud security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch. • Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table. • Shape the product and the playbook. Work directly with Product and R&D leadership, including our co-founder and CTO, and feed what you hear in the field back in a fast loop as the suite matures from early availability to GA. • Build AI Security expertise across the sales team, in addition to closing. • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace. WHAT YOU'LL SELL Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability: • AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost. • AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots. • AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions. • AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended. • AI Security Workbench: Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open. For the right person, that means owning a brand-new motion at the center of a fast-growing company, working directly with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR • 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of personal quota attainment and winning new business. • Hands-on experience selling an AI product, with enough technical and product depth to run the sales cycle as the expert and give our product team credible feedback. • A record of selling in security or closely adjacent infrastructure. • Technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers. • A consultative, challenger style, paired with the hunter instincts to run strategic outbound into new logos. • Comfort operating in ambiguity. The suite and the motion for selling it are still evolving, and much of the playbook will be written by whoever takes this role on. • Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints. NICE TO HAVES • Direct experience selling AI security, cloud security, or other emerging security categories. • Experience as an early seller or builder of a new motion: a first sales hire, a founding seller, or a new product line launched inside a larger company. • Experience in an overlay, specialist, or advisory role in cybersecurity or AI, or a record of selling into CISOs and security leaders. • Experience selling early-availability products and shaping design partner deals. Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Base salary range: $157,250 — $185,000 USD A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards. Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please click here . If you would like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/abnormal-ai-security-sales-executive-north-central

title: Bybit: Business Development Assistant
description: Headquarters: Europe - Remote About Us Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance. Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution. Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services. About the Role *Pls kindly note this role has no base salary, it's commission based We are looking for a internationally minded Regional Business Development Specialist to drive the expansion of Bybit’s payments ecosystem across EU and emerging global corridors. This role will focus on community building, merchant acquisition, local payment partnerships, and strategic growth initiatives for Bybit Pay, Card, and Fiat channels. The ideal candidate has deep experience in payments, fintech, or crypto, strong local market understanding, and a proven track record of driving regional growth. Key Responsibilities: • Support market expansion for Bybit Pay across EU, building and owning the full growth pipeline • Acquire and manage merchants, payment gateways, fintech partners, Web3 projects, community leaders, and other growth channels. • Drive the end-to-end BD cycle: market mapping, lead generation, pitching, negotiation, and partnership execution. • Collaborate with internal teams (Product, Card, Fiat Channels, Compliance, Payments Ops, Marketing) to activate and scale payment use cases. • Develop regional GTM strategies and identify high-potential payment corridors for crypto-to-fiat and fiat-to-crypto flows. • Support cross-border payment products, including settlement channels, payout solutions, and merchant integrations. • Provide market intelligence, partner feedback, and competitive analysis to optimize product direction. • Represent Bybit in industry events, conferences, and ecosystem partnerships. Requirements: • 1+ years of experience in payments / fintech / PSP / acquiring / merchant growth / crypto BD. • Long-term overseas work or study experience (must-have). • Strong understanding of local payment rails, fiat/crypto conversion flows, card programs, and merchant needs. • Demonstrated success in driving regional growth or launching payment products in multiple markets. • Ability to work independently and thrive in fast-paced, high-ownership environments. • Native local language proficiency + strong English communication skills. • Network across fintech, Web3, PSPs, acquirers, or merchant ecosystems is highly preferred. Preferred Qualifications • Understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements for payments and cross-border movement. • Background working in global remote teams. • Prior experience with crypto exchanges, payment gateways, or card programs. Why Join Us At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include: - Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning. - Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation. - Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world. - Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company. - Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bybit-business-development-assistant

description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. title: Retention and Growth Project & AI Coordinator (f/m/d)
Junior Finance & Operations (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

About GENUINE

GENUINE is Europe’s leading TikTok Shop agency, and we’re right in the middle of the social commerce revolution. We don’t just make content. We build shopping experiences that sell, at the speed of a viral trend. We’re growing fast, and so does our Finance & Operations team.

The Mission

Behind every viral LIVE and every creator campaign, a lot of money moves: platform fees, creator commissions, client payouts. You’ll help keep all of it clean, on time and under control. You’ll see how a hypergrowth agency really runs, and you’ll learn more in a few months than in most full-time jobs.

What You’ll Do

  • Follow the money: Own the monthly reconciliation of TikTok Shop settlements, fees and affiliate commissions against our records, and close every gap.
  • Turn data into insights: Build and own the reports that show which clients, creators and LIVE sessions actually make money.
  • Run creator payouts: Manage the payout process end to end, from checking invoices to making sure everyone gets paid correctly and on time.
  • Keep the books tidy: Prepare the monthly close with accounting and our tax advisor, so everything is complete and on time.
  • Automate the boring stuff: Drive the setup of tools that connect TikTok Shop data with our accounting software, and improve our processes as we scale.
  • Have a say in strategy: Run analyses for pricing, client offers and leadership decisions, and present your findings to management.

Your profile

Who You Are

  • Background: You’ve finished a degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Business Informatics or something similar.
  • Experience: You have first experience in finance, controlling or operations, through a working student job, internship or 1–2 years in a full-time role.
  • Excel nerd: Pivot tables and XLOOKUP don’t scare you. You enjoy finding patterns in messy data.
  • Detail lover: A missing cent bothers you, and you won’t rest until you find it.
  • Owner mindset: You’re comfortable in organized chaos, you take responsibility for your topics, and you get things done without being chased.
  • Bonus points: You’ve worked in e-commerce or at an agency before, or you already know TikTok Shop, Shopify, Moss or Spendesk.
  • Language: You speak fluent English. German is nice to have, but you don’t need it.

Why us?

  • Real ownership from day one: You’ll work directly with the Finance & Operations Manager and the Managing Director, and own your own area.
  • Inside view: You’ll see social commerce from the inside, at the agency running 60+ TikTok Shops across Europe.
  • Great team: We’re young, international and based in the heart of Cologne.
  • Room to grow: As we scale, so does your role. There’s a clear path to more responsibility in Finance & Operations.

title: AI Engineering, Growth
Afstudeerstage AI Adoption
description:
Wil jij helpen om AI van technologie naar dagelijks werk te brengen?

Bij HG geloven we dat technologie mensen sterker maakt. Daarom hebben we de afgelopen periode een stevig fundament gelegd voor AI binnen onze organisatie. Microsoft Copilot is geïntroduceerd, er zijn verschillende AI-initiatieven gestart en steeds meer collega’s ontdekken wat AI voor hun werk kan betekenen.

De volgende stap is opschalen. Want AI beschikbaar maken is één ding. Zorgen dat mensen het daadwerkelijk goed gebruiken, er nieuwe vaardigheden mee ontwikkelen en hun manier van werken aanpassen, is waar de echte transformatie plaatsvindt.

Als afstudeerstagiair AI Adoption help je ons om die volgende stap te zetten.

Je komt terecht in een internationale organisatie waar samenwerking, initiatief en nieuwsgierigheid centraal staan. Je begint dus niet vanaf nul. Je bouwt verder op wat er al staat en helpt ons te ontdekken welke aanpak nodig is om AI-adoptie verder te versnellen.

Je combineert onderzoek met praktijk. Je analyseert hoe AI wordt gebruikt, vertaalt data naar concrete acties, ontwikkelt en geeft trainingen voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus en helpt collega’s om AI steeds beter toe te passen in hun dagelijkse werk.

De exacte onderzoeksopdracht bepalen we samen, zodat deze aansluit bij jouw opleiding, interesses en afstudeereisen.

HG is een compacte, snelgroeiende en internationale organisatie waar je direct de impact van je werk ziet. Dit vraagt om eigenaarschap, initiatief en een pragmatische, resultaatgerichte houding. De cultuur is open en stimuleert het delen van ideeën, constructieve samenwerking en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Alles wat we doen is gebaseerd op onze kernwaarden: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.

Wat ga je doen?

Binnen HG zijn de eerste stappen in AI-adoptie al gezet. Er is dus een fundament om op voort te bouwen. Tijdens jouw stage help je ons om naar brede, structurele adoptie te gaan.

Concreet ga je onder andere:

  • Praktische en inspirerende Copilot-demo’s geven aan verschillende groepen medewerkers.

  • Bestaande adoptiedata analyseren en vertalen naar inzichten en concrete acties om gebruik en impact te vergroten.

  • Onderzoeken waar adoptie achterblijft en welke interventies kunnen helpen om medewerkers verder te brengen.

  • AI-trainingsprogramma’s ontwerpen en uitvoeren voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus, van collega’s die net beginnen tot ervaren gebruikers.

  • Trainingen, workshops, oefeningen en praktische hulpmiddelen ontwikkelen waarmee medewerkers AI direct in hun eigen werk kunnen toepassen.

  • De Copilot Academy op ons intranet verder ontwikkelen en actueel en relevant houden.

  • Medewerkers meenemen in de bredere AI-transformatie en concreet maken wat AI voor hun eigen werkzaamheden betekent.

  • Het AI Champions-programma ondersteunen en verder helpen ontwikkelen.

  • Feedback en behoeften van medewerkers ophalen en vertalen naar verbeteringen in trainingen, communicatie en andere adoptie-initiatieven.

  • Onderzoeken welke activiteiten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan meer gebruik, betere AI-vaardigheden en waarde voor de organisatie.

Jouw onderzoek en werkzaamheden helpen HG om AI niet alleen beschikbaar te maken, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van de dagelijkse manier van werken.

Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met onze AI Transformation Lead en hebt veel contact met collega’s uit verschillende afdelingen binnen de organisatie. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van zowel de menselijke als bedrijfskundige kant van AI-transformatie.

Omdat HG actief is in meer dan 45 landen, werk je bovendien in een internationale omgeving waarin verschillende functies, perspectieven en niveaus van AI-volwassenheid samenkomen.

“We beginnen bij HG niet meer vanaf nul met AI. Er ligt een fundament en steeds meer collega’s werken ermee. De interessante vraag is nu: hoe zorgen we dat AI voor veel meer mensen écht onderdeel wordt van hun dagelijkse werk? Ik zoek iemand die het leuk vindt om daar samen met mij de volgende stap in te zetten.”
– Els Marchal, AI Transformation Lead


Wie ben je?

  • Je volgt een relevante hbo-opleiding, zoals Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, ICT, Business Informatics, Data & Business, Human Resource Management, Learning & Development, Communicatie of vergelijkbaar.

  • Je hebt interesse in AI én de manier waarop mensen nieuwe technologie adopteren.

  • Je vindt het leuk om voor groepen te staan en anderen iets nieuws te leren.

  • Je kunt complexe onderwerpen op een eenvoudige en praktische manier uitleggen.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en gestructureerd.

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en stelt kritische vragen.

  • Je vindt het interessant om data te analyseren en inzichten te vertalen naar concrete acties.

  • Je kunt goed schakelen tussen verschillende doelgroepen en niveaus van AI-ervaring.

  • Je vindt het leuk om trainingen, materialen en nieuwe manieren van leren te ontwikkelen.

  • Je durft initiatief te nemen en ideeën in de praktijk uit te proberen.

Ervaring met tools zoals Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT en Power BI is een pre. Belangrijker is dat je nieuwsgierig bent naar AI en enthousiast wordt van de vraag: hoe zorgen we ervoor dat mensen AI daadwerkelijk goed gaan gebruiken?

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een afstudeeropdracht met directe impact op de organisatie.

  • Intensieve begeleiding door de AI Transformation Lead.

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap.

  • De kans om ervaring op te doen met AI-adoptie en organisatieverandering.

  • Praktijkervaring met het ontwikkelen en geven van AI-trainingen, demo’s en workshops.

  • De mogelijkheid om met echte adoptiedata te werken en te onderzoeken welke interventies daadwerkelijk effect hebben.

  • Een actieve rol binnen het AI Champions-programma.

  • Werken aan actuele AI-vraagstukken binnen een internationale organisatie.

  • Een hybride werkomgeving vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Almere.

  • Een informele en betrokken werksfeer waarin samenwerking centraal staat.

  • Stagevergoeding van €450,- bruto per maand (obv 32 uur).

Aan het einde van je stage heb je niet alleen een sterke afstudeerscriptie, maar ook praktische ervaring opgedaan met AI-adoptie, training en organisatieverandering binnen een internationale organisatie. Je hebt zelf trainingen en demo’s gegeven, met echte adoptiedata gewerkt en gezien wat ervoor nodig is om medewerkers daadwerkelijk mee te krijgen in een AI-transformatie.

Wij zijn HG!

Bij HG, een toonaangevend Europees merk in specialistische reinigings- en onderhoudsproducten, geloven we dat een huis een plek moet zijn waar je zorgeloos kunt leven. Met aandacht voor de plek waar je woont en voor de spullen die je omringen. Daarom ontwikkelen wij onze producten zo dat ze veilig doen wat ze beloven.

De missie van HG is om jou te helpen optimaal van je huis te genieten, zonder je zorgen te maken over wat er mis kan gaan. Dit realiseren wij met onze zeer effectieve, veilige en specialistische reinigingsoplossingen, gecombineerd met deskundig advies.

Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Almere zetten wij ons dagelijks in voor superioriteit, innovatie, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid. Met een sterke aanwezigheid in Europa en daarbuiten blijven wij continu investeren om een nog grotere impact te maken.

HG doet wat het belooft.

Nog vragen?

Onze collega Ilse de Groot (Corporate Recruiter) neemt alle tijd om antwoord te geven. Je kan haar bereiken via de mail: ----- style="min-height: 1.7em;">

Solliciteren naar deze afstudeerstage bij HG?

Dat kan! Solliciteer direct en stuur je CV op. We streven ernaar om je binnen 5 werkdagen een reactie te sturen.
